fields.summary_ko.0: AMD posted strong Q3 results with revenue of $13.38B (exceeding consensus of $13.08B) and data center revenue of $8.5B (up 97% YoY), but stock moved little to $483.34.
fields.summary_ko.1: AMD provided 2027 revenue growth guidance of 80% and above, but BofA cut target from $720 to $650 and Mizuho significantly reduced target from $705 to $610.
